source_policy: No new original paper: reuse physical-environment-registration source_bindings and its UPF/Peierls and Maxwell derivations; authenticate original bindings before actual work.
construction: At fixed complete raw Psi and independently supplied complex D, Q(X,Y)=Tr(D X^dagger d Y)=sum(conj(X)*(d Y D)), X=B_x^dagger Psi. No occupations, filling, Gram, Hermitization, real projection or spin degeneracy is substituted.

Exact UPFRadial evaluates F,F_s,F_ss once per species per PW row block. All Cartesian B,B_i,B_ij are formed from the existing regular solid-harmonic derivative identity. Atom placement exp(-ip.tau) remains unshifted at a=0. Wide overlaps collect 10 field jets, 9 ionic jets and 10 legacy ionic/value jets per atom (29*nh columns); no PW-square matrix, local FFT or full H action.

L_i=2p_i+ B_i d B^dagger+B d B_i^dagger. C_ij=2delta_ij I+B_ij d B^dagger+B_i d B_j^dagger+B_j d B_i^dagger+B d B_ij^dagger. J_Ha=-L/2. Kinetic density row contraction is sum(conj(Psi)*(Psi D)); full independent complex trace order survives.

At zero field delta V=V_UPF-V_A25 is computed with the SAME D. Ionic derivatives are B_u=-ip_u B and B_uv=-p_u p_v B; subtract legacy energy, positive gradient and onsite curvature separately, force=-gradient. Different atom mixed derivatives of this one-center nonlocal scalar are zero, not a missing electron-mediated response.

Unitary geometric transport: p_t=R p_s, a_t=R a_s, tau_t=R tau_s+translation modulo cell, H_NL,t(a)=U H_NL,s(R^T a) U^dagger for rotationally scalar ordinary NC UPF d. Thus L_t=R L_s, C_t=R C_s R^T, scalar deltaE invariant and ionic delta gradients/onsites follow saved atom pullback and R. Check d commutes with rotation representation numerically; retain measured saved-geometry residual. This is an approximation at rounded actual geometry, NOT H0 covariance. Reject antiunitary/spin-flip routes.

Checkpoints contain unweighted original-source means. Full aggregate consumes each of 128 spin/mesh slots once with its slot.weight. Separate original-source-weight diagnostic uses XML point.weight once and is never added to the full-grid result. Require all 20 source checkpoints and complete slot coverage.
joint_scalar_limit: Zero-field nonlocal correction joins the A25 scalar only at fixed prepared density and zero field; does not establish transported H0, moving-density SCF consistency, finite-field ionic derivatives, self-consistent response, or an ionic/field quantum state. No anchored undressed constant is called gauge-covariant.
oracle: independent literal angular/radial differentiated integrals and dense PW operators
full complex D trace, kinetic and nonlocal first/second derivatives and mixed contact
zero-field nonlocal energy/ionic gradient/curvature correction and finite differences
independent dense rotation covariance and source/slot weights
phase, conjugation, source-weight duplication, mixed-leg omission, kinetic omission and current sign mutations
execution: Workers do not execute. Root runs oracle first, then --mode estimate, --mode source for each original source, then --mode aggregate with all checkpoint paths. No coefficients or field state invented.

metadata_measurement.method: Read JSON/XML dimensions and count bytes/operations only; no scientific implementation or numerical oracle executed.
metadata_measurement.qualification: Arithmetic estimates count overlap and kinetic BLAS only, not radial special functions, coefficient contractions, loading, hashing or BLAS packing. Existing background/species beta banks and one source frame are additional resident memory. No throughput measured; source outputs and aggregate are small JSON, no new PW output arrays.

root_commands.source_example: taskset -c 6-10 env OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=5 OMP_NUM_THREADS=5 python proposals/P254-ni-collective-response/attempts/0028/run_full_field_moments_material.py --mode source --spin 1 --source-ik 2 --oracle proposals/P254-ni-collective-response/attempts/0028/full-field-moments-oracle-001.json --output proposals/P254-ni-collective-response/attempts/0028/full-field-source-1-2-001
root_commands.complete_source_route: Repeat source command for precisely the 20 (spin,source_ik) records in full-reference-inputs-004.json, one fresh directory each. No partial source is promoted to material.
root_commands.aggregate_route: Same material CLI --mode aggregate --geometry-policy declared-geometric --oracle ORACLE --output FRESH_DIRECTORY with exactly 20 --source-checkpoint SOURCE_DIRECTORY/result.json arguments. Every original source must occur once. Aggregate does not rerun source physics.
